title: Frontend development
summary: Builds what runs in the browser — pages, components, styles — and builds it with the project's own tooling.

role.title: Frontend engineer
role.for: what runs in the browser: pages, components, styles and scripts
role.brief: Make it work before making it pretty, and check it at phone width. Use the project's own package scripts to build and test, and report what they printed.

skills: Semantic HTML first; a button is a <button>.
No layout that scrolls sideways at 360px wide.

requires.why: runs the project's build and test scripts

conventions: Dependencies declared in package.json, never copied in by hand
